'''Phase 3 Carbon Plating''' was a defense related upgrade for [[Podracer/Legends|Podracers]]. The [[Carbon/Legends|carbonized]] plating allowed Podracers to withstand punishment from other [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] or rough terrain better than stock parts or upgrades of inferior quality, such as the [[T100 Dual Power Absorber]]. The upgrade's price ranged to 950 [[Trugut/Legends|truguts]] or more.<ref name="Guide" /> During the [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]]<ref name="RR2" /> [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] season, the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Merchant/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] sold this upgrade to [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer pilots]] from his [[Watto's garage|garage]].<ref name="Guide" /> The Phase 3 Carbon Plating upgrade was outclassed by the [[Phase 5 Carbon Plating]] upgrade.<ref name="Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Phase 3 Carbon Plating was first mentioned in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]'', and was available as a Podracer upgrade that players could purchase. The carbon plating was not clearly visible to the player.<ref name="RR" /> The upgrade was mentioned again in the game's [[Star Wars: Racer Revenge: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]].<ref name="Guide" />
